title: Representable Hom commutes with pointwise right Kan extension, including its counit
statement:
Fix a universe $\mathcal V$ [def-weil-size-convention], $\mathcal V$-small categories $C,D$ [def-nagata-category], a functor $L:C\to D$, and a locally $\mathcal V$-small category $\mathcal A$ admitting all $\mathcal V$-small limits. Use the pointwise right Kan functors $T_{\mathcal A}$ and $T_{\mathrm{set}}$ and counits $\epsilon^{\mathcal A},\epsilon^{\mathrm{set}}$ for precomposition $P$ along $L$ [lem-trf-small-pointwise-right-kan-adjunction]. For $a\in\mathcal A$, set $H_a(x)=\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal A}(a,x)$ and $H_a(f)(z)=f\circ z$. There is an isomorphism of set-valued functors
$$\chi_F:H_a\circ T_{\mathcal A}F\xrightarrow{\sim}T_{\mathrm{set}}(H_a\circ F),$$
natural in $F:C\to\mathcal A$. It identifies the counits: for every $c\in C$,
$$\epsilon^{\mathrm{set}}_{H_aF,c}\circ\chi_{F,Lc}=H_a(\epsilon^{\mathcal A}_{F,c}).$$
All diagrams and limits in this statement are small in $\mathcal V$; $\mathcal A$ need not have a small collection of objects.

mathlib_match.how: Specialize G to coyoneda.obj (op a). coyoneda_preservesLimits (Limits/Yoneda.lean:181-182) supplies limit preservation; preservesPointwiseRightKanExtensionAtOfPreservesLimit (Preserves.lean:452-458) and preservesPointwiseRKEOfHasPointwiseAndPreservesPointwise (462-467) supply the required preservation instances. The natural comparison is ranCompIsoOfPreserves (534-549), with its component rightKanExtensionCompIsoOfPreserves (405-411); the counit clause is exactly rightKanExtensionCompIsoOfPreserves_hom_fac_app (426-430). Existence instances on both sides follow from V-smallness and completeness as in the statement dependency.
